about: Hand-maintained: the visible capability each release added or fixed. Website/tools/SiteSpecimens draws each 'visual' with CodeGlyphX and records it in data/visuals.json; the changelog shows it beside the release notes for 'tag'.

highlights.title: QR artwork with styled modules and finders
highlights.summary: Module shapes, finder frames and palettes configured apart from encoding, with scan heuristics.

highlights.title: One scanner for every family
highlights.summary: SymbolScanner finds QR, Data Matrix, Aztec and linear codes in one image, with limits and status.

highlights.title: Code 39 character patterns corrected
highlights.summary: Standard Code 39 bars now match the specification for every character.

highlights.title: GS1 DataBar Expanded, reimplemented
highlights.summary: Rewritten encoder with better SVG interoperability.

highlights.title: Micro QR, complete
highlights.summary: All M1 to M4 sizes, encoded and recognized from images.

highlights.title: Industrial and logistics barcodes
highlights.summary: ITF-14 and the 2 of 5 family for cartons and pallets.

highlights.title: Data Matrix generation fixed
highlights.summary: Correct symbols across sizes, plus matrix render helpers.

highlights.title: Transparent backgrounds
highlights.summary: QR codes on a transparent background composite correctly.

highlights.title: QR codes in the console
highlights.summary: ASCII output that terminals and logs can show.

highlights.title: Connected modules and the QR art API
highlights.summary: ConnectedSquircle modules, art presets and canvas frames.

highlights.title: First release
highlights.summary: QR, linear and 2D codes in pure managed .NET.
